run_finetune_vit: run the MAE fine-tuning script for ViT image classification with argparse CLI
run_evaluate_checkpoint: run evaluation only mode on a pre-trained ViT checkpoint using --eval flag
run_finetune_from_pretrained: run fine-tuning from a pre-trained MAE checkpoint using the --finetune argument
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training for ViT fine-tuning with DDP support
run_mixup_training: run training with mixup and cutmix augmentation enabled via CLI arguments
